name: jira-service-management-mcp
description: Every Jira Service Management Cloud request-API (servicedeskapi) and Assets endpoint in one binary, plus SLA breach radar, internal notes, ticket timelines, and CMDB-to-ticket joins.

jira_service_management_api_token.title: Atlassian API token
jira_service_management_api_token.description: Atlassian API token from id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens (Basic auth password).

jira_service_management_cloud_id.title: Assets cloudId (optional)
jira_service_management_cloud_id.description: Assets only: your site's cloudId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.

jira_service_management_site.title: Site subdomain
jira_service_management_site.description: Your Atlassian site subdomain: acme for acme.atlassian.net.

jira_service_management_workspace_id.title: Assets workspaceId (optional)
jira_service_management_workspace_id.description: Assets only: your site's workspaceId. Leave blank if you do not use Assets; 'cmdb discover' prints it.

jira_service_management_base_url.title: Base URL override (optional)
jira_service_management_base_url.description: Optional. Replaces the request-API root built from your site. Leave blank: set the site instead, because this override also redirects Assets calls.

jira_service_management_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
jira_service_management_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to drop the MCP server's write tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to make changes.

jira_service_management_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
jira_service_management_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

jira_service_management_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
jira_service_management_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Atlassian. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
